label: Pixal3D Multi-View
description: Pixal3D multi-view to 3D: images 1-4 are the front, left, back and right views of the same object (backgrounds auto-removed); unused slots are pruned, so 1-4 views all run and the first one sets the front. Graph from ComfyUI's official 3d_pixal3d_multi_views template (fov 20, for multi-view generators and rig renders). Requires pixal3d_multiview_int8_convrot + the TRELLIS.2 VAEs + dino_v3_L_naf + birefnet. Optional custom param: seed.

image.error: Pixal3D Multi-View needs at least one upstream image — images 1-4 are the front, left, back and right views.
